subject: Potential telemetry anomaly — request for forensic playbook & sample logs
messages:
From: TerraBank Security <security@terrabank.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Potential telemetry anomaly — request for forensic playbook & sample logs

Hi Ben,

We observed a short-lived spike in inference requests tied to a small set of API keys for our TerraBank private deployment around 2026-05-13T22:40Z. At this point we cannot rule out a misconfiguration versus unauthorized activity. Our compliance team needs: 1) Redwood's forensic/forensic-playbook for incidents affecting private deployments, 2) a small sample of telemetry (S3 access logs, audit trail entries, inference telemetry with token-level metadata if available, and any KV cache access traces), and 3) a SIG/CAIQ mapping or SOC 2 control crosswalk for the controls relevant to telemetry retention and key management.

Time is tight — TerraBank audit asked for an initial packet within 48 hours. Can you confirm what you can provide and an approximate delivery ETA? We are also looping in BrightAudit (cc'd) who will help triage.

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement.

Regards,
Dana Li
Head of InfoSec — TerraBank
security@terrabank.com

Attachments: (none in initial request)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: TerraBank Security <security@terrabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Potential telemetry anomaly — request for forensic playbook & sample logs

Dana — thanks for the heads up. We can support this. Immediate notes and proposed timeline: 

- Acknowledged: We will create an initial artifact bundle (forensic checklist + sample telemetry) within 24 hours and a fuller packet within 72 hours.
- What we'll include in the initial bundle: Redwood forensic playbook (play-by-play steps we run for Private deployments), a CSV extract of S3 access records (sample window containing the spike), anonymized inference telemetry (token counts only; we will not share prompt text unless explicitly authorized), and an audit trail slice for the affected tenant.
- Key management: Redwood Private supports customer KMS/HSM. We'll include a note on key usage and any rotation events during the window.
- Controls mapping: we have a SIG/CAIQ crosswalk; Marissa will attach the control map and the SOC 2 evidence index.

Immediate ask for you: please confirm the affected tenant ID and the exact 30-minute window you want us to focus on (we see multiple spikes across regions). If you prefer, we can convene a 60-minute tabletop tomorrow to go through containment and evidence expectations — propose 2026-05-15 09:00 PT.

Mutual action plan (short):
- Ben: initial packet in 24h (forensic_playbook + telemetry sample) — attach redwood_forensic_playbook_v1.pdf and s3-telemetry-sample-20260513.csv (stubs).
- Marissa/Karthik: produce SIG mapping + retention notes.
- TerraBank: confirm tenant ID and 30-min window; provide any additional scope for logs (db audit, ingress IP list).

We will redact any PII and only include metadata necessary for triage unless you authorize more.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_forensic_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB) — draft playbook; s3-telemetry-sample-20260513.csv (CSV, 45 KB) — anonymized sample

- Karthik: please include a short note describing how KV cache traces are captured and whether they can be correlated to request ids.

- sig-control-mapping.xlsx (SIG/CAIQ crosswalk)
- short README.txt with redaction/PII notes and delivery checklist

I will also prepare a one-page SOC 2 evidence index referencing where auditors can find the primary artifacts in our console (we'll include a console link).

Marissa Cole
